## Shared scenes

> During class at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Unhappy with the separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her warmly and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sends her a secret note. Over the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) focuses fiercely on her studies and engages in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally leaping onto visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reacts furiously.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact [Elaine](../character/elaine.md) on a leaky flat boat, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stranded on a bridge pile when the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly rejects his attempt to apologize and become friends. Back home, after discussing the day's lesson on avoiding over-romanticism with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep a little romance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who buy her a green evening dress. After moving to town, she attends her first day at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and their [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates, only to face intense homesickness in her boarding house until [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming new friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while keeping up her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends visits with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and keeps her exams in perspective as commencement approaches.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After graduating, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she notices Matthew's failing health and learns about potential financial trouble with the Abbey Bank. [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) lovingly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) he is prouder of her than he would be of a dozen boys.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that her eyesight is failing, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let the home be sold, revealing her decision to forgo her college scholarship and remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends with him.
>

> On the eve of beginning their teaching jobs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate whether corporal punishment is ever necessary in school. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also scoffs at her ideal of governing pupils purely through affection. The next morning, a anxious [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before setting off to school.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive around canvassing their assigned road to raise money for painting the hall on behalf of the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They encounter various eccentric neighbors, including grim Miss Eliza, her optimistic sister Catherine, a stressed husband in an apron, and an overly neat Mrs. White.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their canvassing efforts, encountering a variety of colorful neighbors across [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon hearing that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a newborn son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) seizes the opportunity to secure a large five-dollar donation from the proud father. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute to the cause.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their teaching experiences and future ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses taking in the Keith twins due to their mother's failing health, which she ultimately agrees to do with Anne's encouragement.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about Marilla's improving eyesight and the upcoming [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar, then returns home to learn that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) will remain with them through the fall. She recalls disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for eating forbidden jam, after which she attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) alerts everyone to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) attempt to talk Judson out of it, but he refuses to change his mind.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as they discuss family, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together chatting about ideals, teaching mistakes, studies with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and the true meaning of friendship.
>

> After the guests leave and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss life's disappointments, how to resolve the broken platter, local gossip, and Anne's plan to take the twins on a shore picnic.

> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P67](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0067)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), then visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea and reassures him about his imaginative nature. Upon returning home, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) say his prayers and mend his jealous feelings. Later, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting on how mature and handsome he has become.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P37](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) shares a bedtime story of his good deed with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before she walks to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to meet [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss the progress and upcoming initiatives of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as well as the return of their school teaching friends. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to discuss her busy plan of chores for the following day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_

> After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) publish a mock newspaper note about Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a severe severe hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact predicted day, causing massive devastation to crops, trees, and windows. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, later learning of the damage around town, including the death of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
